The background remains the same domestic setting with soft shadows. (3) The woman removes the ruff from the cat and places it around her own neck. The woman is posed formally with her hands clasped in front of her chest, wearing the sunglasses and the white ruff. The background is now dark and shadowed, creating a dramatic, Renaissance-style portrait effect.
